title: Cardiomyocyte Cell-Cycle Regulation in Neonatal Large Mammals: Single Nucleus RNA-Sequencing Data Analysis via an Artificial-Intelligence-Based Pipeline.
authors: Nguyen, Thanh; Wei, Yuhua; Nakada, Yuji; Zhou, Yang; Zhang, Jianyi
one_liner_zh: 该研究用AI分析猪心肌细胞snRNA-seq数据，虽涉及转录因子TBX5/TBX20表达，但核心是细胞周期与增殖，无蛋白质-DNA互作建模或结合机制研究，与本课题关系微弱。
abstract: Adult mammalian cardiomyocytes have very limited capacity to proliferate and repair the myocardial infarction. However, when apical resection (AR) was performed in pig hearts on postnatal day (P) 1 (AR(P1)) and acute myocardial infarction (MI) was induced on P28 (MI(P28)), the animals recovered with no evidence of myocardial scarring or decline in contractile performance. Furthermore, the repair process appeared to be driven by cardiomyocyte proliferation, but the regulatory molecules that govern the AR(P1)-induced enhancement of myocardial recovery remain unclear. Single-nucleus RNA sequencing (snRNA-seq) data collected from fetal pig hearts and the hearts of pigs that underwent AR(P1), MI(P28), both AR(P1) and MI, or neither myocardial injury were evaluated via autoencoder, cluster analysis, sparse learning, and semisupervised learning. Ten clusters of cardiomyocytes (CM1-CM10) were identified across all experimental groups and time points. CM1 was only observed in AR(P1) hearts on P28 and was enriched for the expression of T-box transcription factors 5 and 20 (TBX5 and TBX20, respectively), Erb-B2 receptor tyrosine kinase 4 (ERBB4), and G Protein-Coupled Receptor Kinase 5 (GRK5), as well as genes associated with the proliferation and growth of cardiac muscle. CM1 cardiomyocytes also highly expressed genes for glycolysis while lowly expressed genes for adrenergic signaling, which suggested that CM1 were immature cardiomyocytes. Thus, we have identified a cluster of cardiomyocytes, CM1, in neonatal pig hearts that appeared to be generated in response to AR injury on P1 and may have been primed for activation of CM cell-cycle activation and proliferation by the upregulation of TBX5, TBX20, ERBB4, and GRK5.
abstract_zh: 成年哺乳动物心肌细胞增殖及修复心肌梗死的能力极为有限。然而，当在出生后第1天（P1）对猪心脏进行心尖切除（AR）并在第28天（P28）诱导急性心肌梗死（MI）时，动物恢复且无心肌瘢痕形成或收缩功能下降的证据。此外，修复过程似乎由心肌细胞增殖驱动，但调控AR(P1)诱导的心肌恢复增强的分子尚不清楚。通过自编码器、聚类分析、稀疏学习和半监督学习，评估了来自胎猪心脏及经历AR(P1)、MI(P28)、AR(P1)与MI联合或未经历任何心肌损伤的猪心脏的单核RNA测序（snRNA-seq）数据。在所有实验组和时间点中鉴定出十簇心肌细胞（CM1-CM10）。CM1仅在P28时的AR(P1)心脏中观察到，并富集表达T-box转录因子5和20（分别为TBX5和TBX20）、Erb-B2受体酪氨酸激酶4（ERBB4）和G蛋白偶联受体激酶5（GRK5），以及与心肌增殖和生长相关的基因。CM1心肌细胞还高表达糖酵解基因，而低表达肾上腺素能信号传导基因，这表明CM1为未成熟心肌细胞。因此，我们在新生猪心脏中鉴定出一簇心肌细胞CM1，其似乎是对P1时AR损伤的响应而产生，并可能通过上调TBX5、TBX20、ERBB4和GRK5而预激活心肌细胞周期激活和增殖。
